description.value:
A unique firearm clearly inspired by Arasaka's Shingen. Its powerful rapid fire comes with a heavy recoil, but eventually you'll find a mutual rhythm to your shots. Could this gun be the one you've been looking for all your life? Many say so, despite the initial negative attitude towards its crude appearance. But what starts out as an oddity often ends up becoming a classic - especially when it's effective, and when it comes to the HA-7 Warden, there's no debate. You're sure to create many beautiful memories together.

Cost: 600eb (Expensive)

Class: SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 40 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Smart Rebuild, SMG Snub Barrel • Mods: None

Special Features: If this weapon used Autofire in the previous Round of combat, its next Autofire Attack may reroll one of its 2d6 damage die, but must use the new total.

Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild, SMG Snub Barrel (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
